theses.title: AI power bottleneck → next-generation geothermal
theses.thesis: AI data-center growth is tightening demand for reliable 24/7 power. Enhanced geothermal can provide firm low-carbon generation close to large loads and is emerging as a direct solution to the power constraint.
evidence: Discovery: geothermal observed 4 vs ~0.033 expected, z≈21.62, BH-adjusted p≈0.00013.
Multiple contemporaneous documents reference the Google/Fervo geothermal agreement, including a 396 MW Utah data-center supply deal.
SEC evidence in ORACLE links geothermal context to power/data-center beneficiaries including CEG and AAON.

companies.note: Electrical infrastructure beneficiary of data-center power buildout.
Pure-play enhanced geothermal exposure; higher asymmetry and higher execution risk.
Reliable power supplier exposed to data-center electricity demand.
HVAC / cooling infrastructure linkage in ORACLE SEC evidence.

theses.next_gate: Needs independent temporal replication before semantic promotion and investment ranking.

theses.title: AI infrastructure → electrical grid bottleneck
theses.thesis: The scarce resource around AI deployment is shifting from chips alone toward power delivery: transformers, switchgear, interconnection, generation capacity and cooling. Picks-and-shovels can capture spend regardless of which AI platform wins.
evidence: Discovery flags shortage with z≈13.99 and BH-adjusted p≈0.00632.
ORACLE SEC evidence links shortage/constraint language to ETN, AMAT, VST, AMD and INTC.
The lexical signal is broad, so only economically specific SEC corroboration is retained.

companies.note: Best current ORACLE fit for electrical bottleneck exposure.
Constraint exposure exists, but signal is less pure than grid equipment.
Beneficiary but not a picks-and-shovels solution to the power bottleneck itself.

theses.next_gate: Disaggregate generic shortage into named physical bottlenecks and validate supplier exposure.

theses.title: Distributed / on-demand RNA therapy manufacturing
theses.thesis: Biopharma manufacturing may shift toward smaller, automated and distributed systems capable of producing personalized RNA therapies near the point of care. The investable angle is likely in enabling tools rather than single drug programs.
evidence: therapy: observed 8 vs ~0.077 expected, z≈28.57, BH-adjusted p≈1.5e-10.
A high-economic-relevance source reports ARPA-H funding for on-demand custom RNA therapy manufacturing.
ORACLE SEC evidence links therapy-related supply/demand language to AAQL and ABEO, but listed-company mapping remains immature.

companies.note: SEC supply evidence exists; not yet a validated picks-and-shovels winner.
Demand/supply evidence exists; requires entity and business-model validation.

theses.next_gate: Map enabling-tool vendors and validate recurring revenue capture before ranking stocks.

theses.title: Hydrogen industrialization and electrochemical infrastructure
theses.thesis: Hydrogen remains a real industrial decarbonization theme, but project economics and demand certainty are weaker than the AI-power thesis. The better opportunity may be in components and electrochemical infrastructure rather than pure hydrogen producers.
evidence: hydrogen: observed 5 vs ~0.163 expected, z≈11.96, BH-adjusted p≈0.00036.
Signal spans multiple research channels but includes semantic noise, so conviction is discounted.
No sufficiently strong listed-company mapping has yet passed ORACLE's economic exposure gate.
theses.next_gate: Require commercial offtake and listed-company revenue exposure before promotion.
